paragraphs.text: Mary O'Kill is a legendary Human Villain from Bablovia .

Mary O'Kill is a member of the League of Dastardly Doom on Bablovia . She is part of the Legion of Evil, the ruling cabal that currently controls the League. She is known to be the inventor of Killbots and wears the frame of one around her legs. Mary has red hair and often holds a metallic umbrella device.
